Description: This Vivace is a former WRC racer that was dug out of a ditch in Finland after an unfortunate incident involving a puddle of mud and a large tree trunk. Seemingly totaled, it was abandoned by its race team and fell into the hands of a high school shop class who rebuilt it with drivetrain components from a normal road going Vivace. It has been entered in the Stunt Arena to advertise the school and hopefully make back the exhorbitant cost of carbon fiber body panels.
